scope: One completed Testing spectator record; no candidate-version or command/receipt evidence
evidence_absent: Submitted action IDs or macro/raw-button choices
Per-decision legal actions and agent-specific observations/visibility
Standing orders, pending-seat sets and server order results/rejections
Skill casts, skill cooldowns, hit attribution, healing source
limitations: Spectator samples are not action logs; move events must not be counted as hero commands.
Unchanged sampled coordinates do not rule out unsampled movement or stale position telemetry.
HP gains accompanying max-HP changes are not by themselves evidence of healing.
Zero recorded structure damage does not establish whether any skill was cast or can damage buildings.
No causal failure or code defect can be established from this replay alone.
